predecessors.name: Yuan dynasty
predecessors.text: Quanzhou and Putian, the cities the Ispah army seized in Fujian

successors.name: Yuan dynasty
successors.text: Quanzhou and Putian, the cities the Ispah army seized in Fujian

ledger.x: 1357 (bridging): the Yuan side fights the Ispah army for Putian and the approach to Fuzhou.
March 1357: the Ispah army, led by Sayf ad-Din and Amir ad-Din, seizes Quanzhou.
1362: the Ispah army collapses into internal conflict and Yawuna, a Quanzhou Arab Sunni official, becomes its leader.
1366: Chen Youding crushes the Ispah army and Quanzhou returns to the Yuan.

wars.name: Ispah rebellion
wars.outcome: Yuan victory: the Ispah army, which seized Quanzhou in March 1357, splits in 1362 and is crushed by Chen Youding in 1366.

certainty.note: City holdings in Fujian; the pages name Quanzhou, Putian and Fuzhou, never a frontier.
